## Systeemoverzicht

Research-Ready is een volledig statisch platform dat bestaat uit twee complementaire bouwlagen:

1. **Astro** — de marketingsite en navigatie (NL/EN i18n, statisch gerenderd)
2. **Quarto** — automatisch gegenereerde presentaties, rapporten en de cert-prep trainingssite

Alle output wordt gedeployed via **Cloudflare Pages** (directe upload via Wrangler). Er is geen Git-integratie met Cloudflare — elke deploy wordt expliciet getriggerd.

## 2. Build Pipeline — BPMN Procesflow

Het platform kent twee deploypaden: **automatisch via GitHub Actions** (voor Quarto-content zonder ingebedde fonts) en **handmatig via Wrangler** (voor alles of wanneer de PublicPushGate hook de push blokkeert).

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
  START(["Start\n(Auteur schrijft .qmd of .astro"]])

  START --> COMMIT["Auteur commit lokaal"]
  COMMIT --> PUSH_TRY["git push naar main"]

  PUSH_TRY --> GATE{PublicPushGate\nhook actief?}

  GATE -->|"Base64 fonts\ngedetecteerd"| BLOCKED["Push geblokkeerd\n(embed-resources: true)"]
  GATE -->|"Geen base64\n(embed-resources: false)"| GHA_TRIGGER["GitHub Actions\ngetriggerd op push"]

  BLOCKED --> LOCAL_FLOW["Lokale deploybaan"]

  subgraph LOCAL_FLOW["Lokale Deploy (handmatig)"]
    L1["quarto render quarto/presentations/"]
    L2["quarto render quarto/reports/"]
    L3["quarto render quarto/cert-prep/"]
    L4["npm run build"]
    L5["cp -r public/* dist/"]
    L6["wrangler pages deploy dist/\n--project-name research-ready"]
    L1 --> L2 --> L3 --> L4 --> L5 --> L6
  end

  subgraph GHA_FLOW["GitHub Actions (automatisch)"]
    G1["actions/checkout@v4"]
    G2["quarto-dev/quarto-actions/setup@v2"]
    G3["quarto render quarto/presentations/"]
    G4["quarto render quarto/reports/"]
    G5["quarto render quarto/cert-prep/"]
    G6["git add public/\ngit commit + push"]
    G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 --> G5 --> G6
  end

  GHA_TRIGGER --> GHA_FLOW

  G6 --> CF_DEPLOY["Cloudflare Pages\nontvangen nieuwe bestanden"]
  L6 --> CF_DEPLOY

  CF_DEPLOY --> LIVE(["Site live op\nresearch-ready.nl"])
```

## 3. Deployment Sequencediagram

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
  actor Auteur
  participant Git as GitHub (main)
  participant GHA as GitHub Actions
  participant Quarto as Quarto CLI
  participant Astro as Astro CLI
  participant CF as Cloudflare Pages

  Auteur->>Git: git push (quarto/** of src/**)

  alt Pad A: GHA automatisch (geen base64)
    Git->>GHA: workflow_dispatch / on push
    GHA->>Quarto: quarto render quarto/presentations/
    Quarto-->>GHA: public/presentations/*.html
    GHA->>Quarto: quarto render quarto/reports/
    Quarto-->>GHA: public/reports/*.html
    GHA->>Quarto: quarto render quarto/cert-prep/
    Quarto-->>GHA: public/cert-prep/index.html + 7 pagina's
    GHA->>Git: git commit + push (public/**)
    Note over GHA,Git: GHA heeft contents:write permissie
  else Pad B: Lokale deploy (manueel)
    Auteur->>Quarto: quarto render quarto/*/
    Quarto-->>Auteur: public/**
    Auteur->>Astro: npm run build
    Astro-->>Auteur: dist/ (Astro pagina's)
    Auteur->>Auteur: cp -r public/* dist/
    Auteur->>CF: wrangler pages deploy dist/
  end

  CF-->>Auteur: Deployment URL (*.pages.dev)
  CF->>CF: CDN propagatie (wereldwijd)
  CF-->>Auteur: research-ready.nl live
```

## 5. Cert-Prep Site Architectuur

De cert-prep site gebruikt Quarto's `type: website` project — dit genereert een volledige multi-page site met navbar en sidebar, in tegenstelling tot losse HTML-bestanden.

```{mermaid}
graph TD
  subgraph CERTSITE["Quarto Website Project — quarto/cert-prep/"]
    YML["_quarto.yml\n(type: website, navbar, sidebar, cosmo theme)"]
    IDX["index.qmd\n→ /cert-prep/\n(overzicht + vergelijkingstabel)"]
    SP["sec-plus.qmd\n→ /cert-prep/sec-plus"]
    CY["cysa-plus.qmd\n→ /cert-prep/cysa-plus"]
    SC9["sc-900.qmd\n→ /cert-prep/sc-900"]
    SC3["sc-300.qmd\n→ /cert-prep/sc-300"]
    SC2["sc-200.qmd\n→ /cert-prep/sc-200"]
    CC["ccna.qmd\n→ /cert-prep/ccna"]
    AZ["az-500.qmd\n→ /cert-prep/az-500"]
    CSS["cert-style.css\n(Research-Ready branding)"]
  end

  YML --> IDX
  YML --> SP & CY & SC9 & SC3 & SC2 & CC & AZ
  CSS -->|"html.css:"| YML

  IDX --> NAV["Navbar: Overzicht | Certifications ▾"]
  IDX --> SIDE["Sidebar: alle 8 pagina's"]

  subgraph OUT["Output: public/cert-prep/"]
    HTML_IDX["index.html"]
    HTML_CERTS["sec-plus.html\ncysa-plus.html\nsc-900.html\nsc-300.html\nsc-200.html\nccna.html\naz-500.html"]

  end

  IDX --> HTML_IDX
  SP & CY & SC9 & SC3 & SC2 & CC & AZ --> HTML_CERTS
```

## 6. Technische Stack

| Laag | Technologie | Versie / Config |
|---|---|---|
| Marketingsite | Astro | Static, NL/EN i18n |
| Presentaties | Quarto + RevealJS | `embed-resources: true`, custom SCSS |
| Rapporten | Quarto + HTML | Cosmo theme, externe CSS |
| Cert-Prep | Quarto Website | `type: website`, sidebar + navbar |
| CI/CD | GitHub Actions | `quarto-dev/quarto-actions/setup@v2` |
| Deploy | Cloudflare Pages | Direct upload via Wrangler 4.x |
| CDN | Cloudflare | Automatische `.html` stripping (308) |
| Auth | CF API Token | Pages Write scope |
| Security (lokaal) | PublicPushGate hook | Blokkeert base64 in public repo push |

---

## 7. Bekende Beperkingen & Ontwerpkeuzes

| Beslissing | Reden |
|---|---|
| CF Pages = directe upload (geen Git-integratie) | Project was als empty geïnitialiseerd; Wrangler geeft meer controle |
| `embed-resources: false` voor cert-prep | Voorkomt base64-font inbedding → PublicPushGate niet getriggerd |
| `embed-resources: true` voor presentaties | RevealJS vereist self-contained HTML voor offline gebruik |
| Geen R/Python engine in GHA | Code blocks als plain fences, geen `{r}` of `{python}` → geen runtime nodig |
| CSS via `css:` key, niet in `theme:` array | Quarto verwacht SCSS layer markers in `theme:`; plain CSS mag alleen via `css:` |
| GHA heeft `contents: write` permissie | Bot commit van gegenereerde Quarto output terug naar repo |

## 8. ITIL Service Management

Research-Ready volgt de ITIL v4 Service Lifecycle als kader voor service delivery, change management en continual improvement.

### 8.1 ITIL Service Lifecycle

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  subgraph SS["Service Strategy"]
    SS1["Platformdoel:\nAutomatische kennisdeling\nvoor security professionals"]
    SS2["Service Portfolio:\nPresentaties · Rapporten\nCert-Prep · Marketingsite"]
  end

  subgraph SD["Service Design"]
    SD1["Quarto pipeline ontwerp\n(render → output → dist)"]
    SD2["Availablity: Cloudflare CDN\nSecurity: PublicPushGate\nCapacity: Statisch = onbeperkt"]
    SD3["Service Catalog\n(zie §8.3)"]
  end

  subgraph ST["Service Transition"]
    ST1["Change Management\n(git commit = RFC)"]
    ST2["Release Management\n(Wrangler deploy = release)"]
    ST3["CMDB: GitHub repo\n= Configuration Item record"]
  end

  subgraph SO["Service Operation"]
    SO1["Availability monitoring:\nCF Pages dashboard"]
    SO2["Incident Management:\n404 / build failures"]
    SO3["Request Fulfillment:\nnieuwe .qmd = service request"]
  end

  subgraph CSI["Continual Improvement"]
    CSI1["PIR na elke deploy\n(HTTP 200 verificatie)"]
    CSI2["Backlog: GitHub Issues\nvoor verbeteringen"]
    CSI3["KPI: build tijd,\npaginasnelheid, uptime"]
  end

  SS --> SD --> ST --> SO --> CSI --> SS
```

---

### 8.2 Change Management — Normal Change Proces

Elke inhoudelijke wijziging doorloopt het ITIL Normal Change proces. De git commit fungeert als **Request for Change (RFC)**.

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
  RFC(["RFC: git commit\n(wijziging in .qmd of .astro)"])

  RFC --> CAT{"Change\nCategorie?"}

  CAT -->|"Content\n(.qmd tekst)"| STANDARD["Standard Change\n(lage impact, pre-approved)"]
  CAT -->|"Infrastructuur\n(workflow, wrangler, CF token)"| NORMAL["Normal Change\n(review vereist)"]

  STANDARD --> IMPACT_S["Impact Assessment:\nPublicPushGate scan\n(automatisch)"]
  NORMAL --> IMPACT_N["Impact Assessment:\nhandmatige review\n+ rollback-plan"]

  IMPACT_S --> GATE_S{Scan OK?}
  IMPACT_N --> APPROVE{Goedkeuring\nplatformbeheerder?}

  GATE_S -->|Ja| BUILD_S["Build:\nGHA of lokale render"]
  GATE_S -->|Nee — base64| REMEDIATE["Remediation:\nembed-resources: false\nof andere fix"]
  REMEDIATE --> RFC

  APPROVE -->|Ja| BUILD_N["Build:\nlokale render + npm build"]
  APPROVE -->|Nee| REJECT(["Change afgewezen\n→ backlog"])

  BUILD_S --> DEPLOY["Deploy:\nwrangler pages deploy dist/"]
  BUILD_N --> DEPLOY

  DEPLOY --> PIR["Post-Implementation Review:\nHTTP 200 verificatie\nop alle gewijzigde URLs"]

  PIR --> OK{Alle URLs\n200 OK?}
  OK -->|Ja| CLOSE(["Change gesloten\nCMDB bijgewerkt"])
  OK -->|Nee| INCIDENT["Incident geopend\n→ Incident Management §8.4"]
  INCIDENT --> ROLLBACK["Rollback:\nvorige Wrangler deploy\nopnieuw uitrollen"]
  ROLLBACK --> PIR
```

### 8.3 Service Catalog

| Service | Type | Doelgroep | Levertijd | Availability | Eigenaar |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Marketing Website | Business Service | Bezoekers / prospects | Continu (CDN) | 99.9% (CF SLA) | Research-Ready |
| Quarto Presentaties | Supporting Service | Klanten / partners | On-demand render (~2 min) | 99.9% | Research-Ready |
| Quarto Rapporten | Supporting Service | Klanten / partners | On-demand render (~1 min) | 99.9% | Research-Ready |

| Build Pipeline (GHA) | IT Service | Platform team | On push (< 5 min) | Afhankelijk van GitHub SLA | GitHub / Research-Ready |

### 8.4 Incident Management

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
  DETECT(["Incident gedetecteerd\n(404, build failure, deploy error)"])

  DETECT --> LOG["Incident gelogd\n(GitHub Issue aanmaken)"]
  LOG --> P{Prioriteit?}

  P -->|"P1 — site down"| P1["Directe actie:\nrollback vorige deploy\nvia Wrangler"]
  P -->|"P2 — pagina 404"| P2["Diagnose:\ncontroleer output-dir\nen URL-mapping"]
  P -->|"P3 — build fout"| P3["Diagnose:\nGHA logs lezen\nquarto render lokaal"]

  P1 --> RESTORE["Herstel:\nwrangler pages deploy\n(vorige dist/)"]
  P2 --> FIX_PATH["Fix:\ncorrectie in _quarto.yml\nof cp commando"]
  P3 --> FIX_BUILD["Fix:\nCSS key, engine, SCSS\n(zie §7 Beperkingen)"]

  RESTORE --> PIR2["PIR: root cause analyse\n→ kennisbank bijwerken"]
  FIX_PATH --> REDEPLOY["Opnieuw deployen"]
  FIX_BUILD --> REDEPLOY

  REDEPLOY --> VERIFY["Verificatie: HTTP 200"]
  VERIFY --> CLOSE2(["Incident gesloten"])
  PIR2 --> CLOSE2
```

---

### 8.5 Configuration Management Database (CMDB)

De GitHub-repository is het centrale **Configuration Management Database (CMDB)**. Elk bestand is een Configuration Item (CI).

| CI Type | Locatie | Verantwoordelijke | Wijzigingsprocedure |
|---|---|---|---|
| Astro broncode | `src/**` | Platform team | Normal Change via PR |
| Quarto content | `quarto/**` | Content team | Standard Change via commit |
| Build workflow | `.github/workflows/` | Platform team | Normal Change — handmatige review |
| Cloudflare API token | KeePass vault | Platformbeheerder | Rotatie elk kwartaal |
| Account ID / Project naam | KeePass vault | Platformbeheerder | Wijziging = infrastructuur change |
| Gegenereerde output | `public/**` | GHA / auteur | Automatisch — geen directe wijziging |
